item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are the two test files, the plan, the evidence page and docs/figures/the-suite-is-green-at-head, and git diff --numstat 587adf48 f972ac68 returns exactly those five paths plus the figure's .png, with nothing under reckon/.

justifications.durability: every assertion the diff adds names the code change that reddens it — the wall bound at tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py:799 fails on a dispatch process that outlives 8.0 s plus its measured import time (I reddened it at 20.108 s against 10.66 s allowed), assert signalled at :839 fails if the boundary scan never charges a call from under the worktree root, the arming bound at tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:233 fails when no tree finishes arming in 20 s (I reddened it with a 25 s constructor), and the two assert started lines at :195 and :221 fail if production stops reaching the patched constructor; the reservations are that those two lines observe a seam the test itself installed, so they prove reachability rather than that real arming work is in flight, and that the wall bound is a deliberate loosening (5.0 to 8.0 plus startup plus DRIVER_EXIT_SLACK) sized above a measured 5.314 s worst case, which leaves the second bound at :806 as the one that catches a stall under about 8 s.
justifications.evidence: the result is recorded rather than claimed and I re-derived it — my own runs at f972ac68 (log recheck-serial.log, 8 passed in 46.79 s with reckon resolving inside the reviewed tree; log recheck-n4.log, 8 passed in 23.21 s) plus two independent mutations of scratch trees built with git archive f972ac68, each with its pristine control green in the same setup (logs negative-control-positive-arm.log 1 passed, negative-control-mutated.log red at tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py:799 on a 15 s sleep at the dispatch entry; negative-control-arming-positive.log 3 passed, negative-control-arming-mutated.log red at tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:233 on a 25 s sleep in _ProjectChangeWatch.__init__); one point withheld because the worker's own gate logs carry no revision, tree or command header, so their attribution rests entirely on the manifest naming it.
justifications.fit: the additions follow the idiom already in these files — bounded constants with the measurement behind each one in a comment beside it (tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py:86-108), the file's own _wait_for poll helper and monkeypatched fixtures — and the three naming checks over the diff's added lines return no plan, sprint, ticket, version or changelog-prose identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: both fixed sleeps the done_when names are gone — SHIM_SLEEP_SECONDS and the shim's sleep ($RECKON_SHIM_SLEEP) no longer exist in tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py, and tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:148 waits on release_arming in place of _ARM_SECONDS_PER_TREE — while every bound the two files asserted is still asserted.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat 587adf48 f972ac68 names the two test files, the plan, the evidence page, the figure and its script and nothing else, the figure script and .png are inside the declared docs/figures/the-suite-is-green-at-head root, and all docs changes are additive against base.
